about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

caWhole(whole) in caBack restores the full DFHCOMMAREA array; runTask's finally block (lines 661-663) unconditionally calls caWhole(caWhole) on task exit anyway, so skipping caWhole here has no effect on subsequent operations

the block runs only for a task not yet ended, and COUSR03C always ends in RETURN / XCTL / an abend; and caBack only writes the task's COMMAREA object back, which for a terminal task is not observable (CICS discards it; linked_result drops it)

without the first entry's MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COUSR3AO, SEND MAP sends the map's initial image values, which are blanks (0x20) and nulls (0x00); equivalence_cics._same strips trailing blanks and nulls so screen comparison values are identical, all attribute/color/highlight positions in IMAGE_s_COUSR3AI are already 0x00, and USRIDINL is explicitly set to -1 immediately following, making the low-values clear completely unobservable
the 'Y' written for an invalid key is never tested afterwards: the SEND that follows does not read ERR-FLG, MAIN-PARA ends in RETURN, and the next task starts from MAIN-PARA's SET ERR-FLG-OFF

`CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM = LOW-VALUES AND = SPACES` for OR: every caller of RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN moves a program name into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM first ('COSGN00C', CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM when it is not blank, else 'COADM01C'), so it is neither, and both conditions are false

condition() returns a value only for a handled, ignored, or ERROR-handled condition; COUSR03C sets no condition handlers, so after an unhandled XCTL failure condition() executes throw abended() and to >= 0 is never tested

SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN is only called immediately before task exit (EXEC CICS RETURN); EIBRESP is never read after SEND MAP, DFHEIBLK is not compared, and the next transaction re-initializes DFHEIBLK in runTask

the SEND MAP condition check is reached only when planned5[0] != 0 (planned faults); no SEND MAP faults are planned in any scenario, and even if planned, COUSR03C sets no condition handlers so condition() throws abended() directly

task.planned("RECEIVE-MAP", ...) queries the mock planned-fault table; no RECEIVE-MAP faults are planned in any scenario, so both "COUSR3A" and "XOUSR3A" return {0, 0}

received map field PGMNAMEI is never read anywhere in COUSR03C's PROCEDURE DIVISION, and SEND MAP overwrites the map fields with POPULATE-HEADER-INFO values, so storing or skipping PGMNAME has no observable effect

received map field TITLE02I is never read anywhere in COUSR03C's PROCEDURE DIVISION, and SEND MAP overwrites the map fields with POPULATE-HEADER-INFO values, so storing or skipping TITLE02 has no observable effect

COUSR03C only reads WS-REAS-CD in DISPLAY statements immediately following READ or DELETE operations; each file READ or DELETE command overwrites WS-REAS-CD from RESP2, so clearing WS-REAS-CD to 0 beforehand is never observed

COUSR03C never reads EIBRESP2 anywhere in its PROCEDURE DIVISION (reads RESP2 into WS-REAS-CD directly), DFHEIBLK is not compared, and each command re-stores EIBRESP2 before any subsequent task could see it
